name: Montemayor de Pililla (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Montemayor de Pililla (a cross on white and a tree on green).
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 5 December 2003 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 22 January 2004; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of three horizontal stripes in proportions 1/6, 4/6 and 1/6, the upper red, the central white and the lower green, bearing the municipal arms on the white stripe at the centre.

features.role: Montemayor de Pililla arms — cross on white and a tree on green
